title: Multi-admin approval is missing for one or more high-impact operations

report.title: {Items.Count} high-impact {Plural(Items.Count, 'operation is', 'operations are')} not covered by multi-admin approval

messages.businessImpact: Approval is in place but does not cover every operation that can reach devices, so the protection can be bypassed simply by choosing a different route.
remediation: Add an access policy for each operation listed.
Use the same approver group so the process stays consistent.
messages.cannotSee: Intune offers no switch on an access policy, so a policy counts as in force when it names an approver group.
